sources.title: Constraining power of asymptotic safety for scalar fields

evidence.text: Resolve metric modes, choose a background-covariant gauge, and consistently include its scalar-background prefactor. The reported α=β=0 limit removes one scalar metric contribution.

sources.title: Fifth-Force Constraints from UV-Complete Scalar-Tensor Gravity

evidence.text: Use the stability matrix and its mixed eigendirections to characterize phase-dependent focusing. Determine a critical initial quartic coupling delimiting regular UV-reaching trajectories, with an asymptotic expression at large initial f1.

sources.title: Constraining power of asymptotic safety for scalar fields

evidence.text: Integrate ultraviolet-complete trajectories after checking their persistence near the fixed point, impose gravitational decoupling at M_Pl, and follow symmetry breaking until threshold freeze-out. The source performs the integrations; no numerical reproduction was undertaken.

sources.title: Constraining power of asymptotic safety for scalar fields

evidence.text: Evaluate the flow at λ_HP=0. A nonzero additive source removes that point as a fixed point. On the reported FP3 branch, finite non-minimal couplings generated by Yukawas provide this source.

sources.title: Constraining power of asymptotic safety for scalar fields

evidence.text: Balance the matter source for the curvature coupling against direct gravitational running, then compare the resulting root with the interval needed for positive f_y. Degenerate coefficients and omitted higher orders require separate treatment.

sources.title: Constraining power of asymptotic safety for scalar fields

evidence.text: Use canonical dimensions to choose a finite operator basis, then test whether interacting exponents stay near their canonical values. This supports internal consistency but supplies no rigorous error estimate for omitted interactions.

sources.title: An asymptotically safe guide to quantum gravity and matter

evidence.text: Review how interacting renormalization-group fixed points can provide predictive ultraviolet completions for matter and gravity, and whether gravity–matter interactions could connect Planck-scale dynamics to observable particle physics.

sources.title: Constraining power of asymptotic safety for scalar fields

evidence.text: How sensitive are scalar-gravity fixed points and their relevant directions to regulator dependence and anomalous-dimension prescriptions? The appendix distinguishes scalar, metric-fluctuation, and background Newton-coupling anomalous dimensions.

sources.title: Quantum scale symmetry

evidence.text: How do fixed points and their deformations organize quantum scale symmetry in particle physics, gravity and cosmology, and what can this explain about the gauge hierarchy, particle couplings and dark energy?

sources.title: Safe essential scalar-tensor theories

evidence.text: Within a complete four-derivative approximation for gravity coupled to a shift-symmetric scalar, do essential couplings admit an asymptotically safe UV completion connected to ordinary IR effective field theory, and what restrictions follow for scalar self-interactions?

sources.title: Quantum Gravity from Dynamical Metric Fluctuations

evidence.text: Can metric quantum gravity possess an interacting UV fixed point with finitely many relevant directions, connect to general relativity and the Standard Model, and admit acceptable Lorentzian spectral properties? This contribution reviews the fluctuation-based functional RG evidence.

sources.title: Harvesting physical predictions from asymptotically safe quantum field theories

evidence.text: How can the UV-critical surface of an interacting RG fixed point be constructed beyond linearization, efficiently enough to extract the allowed infrared effective couplings without tracing individual RG trajectories?
